Use UV for all Python operations. Never use `python -m`, `pip install`, or `python script.py` directly.
`uv run pytest`; `uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/`; `uv pip install package`; `uv run python script.py`
Commands: `make dev`, `make verify`, `make test`, `uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/ -v`, `uv run pytest tests/test_file.py -v`, `uv run pytest -m confidence_check`, `uv run pytest --cov=superclaude`, `make lint`, `make format`, `make doctor`, `make build-plugin`, `make sync-plugin-repo`, `make clean`.
Architecture v4.1.9: Python package, slash commands; pytest plugin/CLI in `src/superclaude/`, tests/, scripts/. Pytest plugin auto-loaded via `pyproject.toml`. Fixtures: `confidence_checker`, `self_check_protocol`, `reflexion_pattern`, `token_budget`, `pm_context`. Read `PLANNING.md`, `TASK.md`, `KNOWLEDGE.md`.
Confidence: ≥90% proceed; 70-89% present alternatives; <70% ask questions. Never guess—verify official docs (Context7 MCP, WebFetch, WebSearch). Validate with tests/docs; no speculation. Prefer MCP tools over speculation for documentation/research.
Use Wave → Checkpoint → Wave; parallelize file reads/edits. Branch flow: `integration` → feature/fix/docs → validate → `master`; conventional commits. Develop with tests: `uv run pytest`; commit: `git commit -m "feat: description"`.
When running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, use `git worktree` to avoid conflicts.
`git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration integration`
`git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-feature feature/pm-agent`
`git worktree remove ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration`
Plugin/TypeScript system, `.claude-plugin/`, marketplace, and project-local detection DO NOT EXIST in v4.1.9; planned v5.0 (#419). `make build-plugin` is planned but not functional. Current slash commands installed via `pipx install superclaude && superclaude install` to `~/.claude/commands/`; `/pm`, `/research`, `/index-repo`.
